decisions.rationale: The paper explicitly establishes a distinct protein/GO knowledge-graph route for XunZi-M: proteins are mapped to gene IDs, PPI and GO links are compiled, nodes are embedded, and stacked GCN layers process the graph. That supports retaining the route and its model-input status; the narrow correction is to mark the evidence as explicit text rather than inferred.
